name: aqmen
description: The aqmen connector plus skills for strategic-decision work on the aqmen platform, organized by use case: a commercial due diligence (CDD) run end to end across market, competition and company; the shared steps any use case drives — scope, research, model, challenge, conclude, deliver, refresh, demo prep — with parallel researchers and adversarial critics; and the pre-project proposal and storyline. Deliverables are decks in the workspace, every figure sourced from the model and exportable to PowerPoint, with an optional HTML report.
